set.body: ADR 0027 §7. A fresh-context agent labels every pair in the candidate universe (same, different, can't tell) from recognized words and frames, blind to proposals and outputs. Frozen by SHA-256; local only (rule 14d); reported as agent judgments. Owner may substitute human labels.
set.title: [evidence-binding S3c-3] Frozen agent labels over the S3c candidate universe
